title: Alternator failure drains the battery until the BCM stores its supply fault
summary: The alternator stops at 0 % while the engine still runs; the 45 A of consumers are paid by the battery alone. The terminal voltage slides through the BCM's window, and the code follows the drain — it is never set by the file.

dtc.because: the drain crosses the BCM's 11.5 V window well before the ten seconds the script gives it
